method: Source rule dispositions plus independent token/byte and primitive matrices. Status is scoped evidence, not an exhaustive equivalence percentage.

tags.decision: Opening delimiter excludes following whitespace; closing delimiter includes one newline. Both short-tag profiles.

inline-html.decision: Only recognized openers enter scripting; binary HTML is preserved.

shebang.decision: compile_file SHEBANG handling becomes a retained comment; tokenizer INITIAL needs oracle normalization.

whitespace.decision: Exactly SP/TAB/CR/LF. CRLF counts once across token consumption boundaries; byte columns are a project API.

comments.decision: Doc classification requires ordinary whitespace after /**. Unterminated comments throw instead of recovery tokens. Trivia is removed before parsing.

identifiers.decision: ASCII letters/underscore plus every byte 80-FF; digits are continuation bytes.

keywords.decision: Case-insensitive scanner keywords use one category; grammar primitives separately constrain identifier legality.

enum.decision: Longer extends/implements lookahead excludes prefixes too. NUL is excluded from lookahead comments.

yield-from.decision: Atomic Zend token is split into two keywords plus retained trivia. A close tag inside a composite lookahead comment does not leave scripting.

variables.decision: Dollar plus LABEL is atomic; extra dollar/braces are separate punctuation even in parser-invalid sequences.

property.decision: LABEL after object operators is an identifier even for keywords. Whitespace/comments retain the state; fallback resumes scripting.

names.decision: Qualified, fully qualified and namespace-relative names are atomic; separators cannot contain trivia.

integers.decision: Spelling determines integer category independently of machine overflow. Legacy octal 8/9 rejection is performed by numeric primitives.

floats.decision: DNUM/EXPONENT_DNUM maximal munch, fraction/exponent separators and dot/ellipsis boundaries. Values/overflow are not lexical correctness.

operators.decision: Longest spelling wins. Ampersand token subcategories collapse; reference placement and delimiter balance are syntactic.

casts.decision: SP/TAB only; canonical and deprecated aliases. Removed real throws in parser mode, unset remains separate rejected syntax. Zend emits T_UNSET_CAST; false && (unset) 1 is a recorded Phase 6 folding discrepancy.

single-strings.decision: One source token, byte escapes retained without value conversion. Unterminated strings throw rather than expose recovery tokens.

double-strings.decision: Aggregate complete source span; scripting/interpolation fragments are checked separately by EBNF.

backticks.decision: Own delimiter with double-string interpolation/escape recognition; commands are never executed by tests.

escapes.decision: Escape bytes are retained. Invalid Unicode escapes fail StringSyntax; conversion values and deprecation delivery are outside scope.

interpolation.decision: Recursive scripting braces, varname/property/offset states; aggregate outer strings. Deprecated dollar-brace forms remain valid. Expression legality belongs to EBNF.

heredoc.decision: Case-sensitive labels require a following non-LABEL byte, including empty bodies. Nested labels and indentation enforced; fragments receive a newline sentinel, whole files preserve EOF.

nowdoc.decision: Separate literal body with no interpolation/escape validation. Same exact label boundary and indentation constraints.

halt.decision: Recognized directive makes all trailing bytes opaque; syntax/scope legality is checked by grammar/contextual layer. Tokenizer recovery for malformed directives is not authoritative acceptance.

bytes.implementation: LexerState; byte LABEL predicates; StringInput/default code-unit primitive
bytes.decision: Raw PHP strings, no UTF-8 decoding. Invalid scripting bytes throw instead of T_BAD_CHARACTER. Encoding conversion filters are outside the raw-byte source profile.

rules.disposition: Raw PHP strings, no UTF-8 decoding. Invalid scripting bytes throw instead of T_BAD_CHARACTER. Encoding conversion filters are outside the raw-byte source profile.

scanner_context_only.reason: The non-primitive path is an unmodified trait alias immediately before a semicolon. enum is then T_STRING, handled by identifier; the T_ENUM lookahead requires a following label-start byte. Earlier coverage incorrectly matched its identifier spelling as a keyword terminal.
scanner_context_only.evidence: docs/8.5/phase5-lexer-audit.md; scanner rules 1568/1572; trait_alias parser production; phase3 keyword-alias corpus

supporting_source.zend_language_scanner.l:300-319 zend_lex: Parser identifier feedback is separate from scanning; semi-reserved primitives and existing declaration fixtures.
supporting_source.zend_language_scanner.l:322-524,879-910: Outside raw-byte profile; no Unicode decoding is promised.
supporting_source.zend_language_scanner.l:928-1148 zend_sc: escapes family; StringSyntax Unicode validity; value conversion intentionally omitted.
supporting_source.zend_language_scanner.l:1153-1240 newlin: whitespace, heredoc, nowdoc families plus syntax-evidence blank/mixed/extra-indentation cases.
supporting_source.zend_language_scanner.l:1254-1357 nestin: Braced interpolation boundary scanner plus EBNF delimiter nesting; recovery diagnostics not reproduced.
supporting_source.zend_language_scanner.l:1371-1392 macros: Byte/digit/operator matrices; NUL-sensitive enum/yield lookahead; 190 state rules below.
supporting_source.zend_language_parser.y:407-410 halt dire: halt family and malformed-argument syntax case; no return to source scanning after valid directive.
supporting_source.zend_language_parser.y:596,859-894 amper: Both scanner ampersands mapped to &, EBNF parameter/reference/intersection fixtures remain mandatory.
supporting_source.zend_language_parser.y:1368; zend_compil: Removed live cast policy preserved; short-circuit folding discrepancy explicitly recorded for Phase 6.

outside_lexical_profile: zend.multibyte input/output encoding conversion and BOM filtering: callers provide already-selected raw source bytes.
Scanner token values, interning, memory limits, event callbacks, diagnostic wording and deprecation delivery.
Delimiter nesting diagnostics and expression legality: EBNF/parser; compiler halt scope and return-only type placements: contextual.
unproven: All possible recursively nested interpolation/heredoc/state combinations; finite deterministic matrices and existing nested corpus are evidence, not a formal proof.
Exact Zend recovery token stream on malformed input; this lexer throws or aggregates invalid string contents for later primitive/EBNF rejection.
AST, contextual legality, constant folding and full language conformance remain Phases 6-7.
